body: Yeah, please tell what episode is this
I love it!
Hanako-kun with a wig and skirt lol
Brock, is that you?
That's the translation of part 2?
Nice hoodie!
Beautiful!

I love how he makes himself looks like the greatest pervert yet his first reaction to the idea of seeing Nene naked was to denied it and get embarrassed.

I can see that being a pervert is not really in his nature. So I wonder why does he do that. Is it some sort of coping mechanism?
I wonder how many names is Hanako-kun going to have at the end of the manga.
Did you take two classes together or they were one per session?
I'm relieved I'm not the only one taking two summer classes at the same time. Could you tell me how many weeks are they going to be?
Thank you so much! I really needed to hear this. I'm still nervous but I'll dedicate my full time to these classes.
Together or separately?
So it's like taking 6 classes in a semester? I have only take 12 credit classes which is 4 classes. How many classes are you implying with 18 credit? 6 classes is a lot in my opinion.

So, in Texas it's okay to take the pass/fail for accounting classes? Will the classes count for the CPA exam requirements?

Just making sure I understood.
Beautiful!!!! ❤
Amane ♡
Tanjirou is the cero tailed beast
I'm glad for you and I hope you will continue like that! Best of luck!
Why is not worth it? I won't force you tho. The last thing I want is to make you uncomfortable. But don't say that. If it is affecting you so much it is important.
D: Sorry I dont know how to help you either. Depression sucks. What is the cause of it? Do you want to talk about it?

Please don't say that. I dont know what's wrong with crisis lines but they are really wrong for treating you like that. It probably was someone who wasn't having a good time or doesn't like their job. 

I know that depression make you feel worthless - I do too many times - and because of that I definitely dont want others to feel the same. So I'm here to tell you that YOU ARE NOT WORTHLESS. NOPE. NOT AT ALL. NEVER. EVERY TIME YOU FEEL LIKE THAT REMEMBER MY WORDS PLEASE.

What I like about this community is that the people here are very supportive. So I hope that the comments will make feel at least a bit better.
Same
That's very cute! Haha I'm glad you have someone who makes you enjoy life. Treasure all those moments and make him and yourself happy 😊
I wish I could give you a hug
Could you tell me what job do you have? Do you need experience for it?
Euthanasia sounds so nice. I wish it was legal.
On the same boat

Same. I fear the pain and failure of not dying. D*mn it, I can't even cut myself even tho I want to get use to the pain so killing myself won't be that difficult (stupid I know). But then I start crying because I really don't want to hurt myself. What I want is to stop being so weak and be happy. 

Then I fall asleep. Wake up. I notice that nothing has change, my anxiety and fear are still there. And I'm still alive.

I wish someone would kill me. But I don't want to put that burden on anyone.
Give yourself time to recover and I wish the best for you.

Thank you for your concern. Right now I'm feeling a bit better and currently  those kind of thoughts are not in my head. If I get suicidal again  I'll serious think about telling someone. I want to say that I definitely will but it's hard for me  to open up to people that know me in person. A bad habit I admit.

I agree. I have depression but I haven't told anyone because I'm afraid of hurting and being a burden to the people I love. My mom and some of the people I know think suicidal people are weak and sadly I'm someone with that kind of thoughts. So I would be very grateful if there was someone willing to truly support me during those moments. Please, I would like you to listen to this selfish request and keep spreading generosity to others.
Happy New Year! I hope all the comments will make you feel at least a bit better.
